Question Stem: If an object moves with uniform acceleration, what is the formula for distance s after time t?
A. s = vt

Rationale: Applies to uniform velocity only, not uniform acceleration.

B. s = ut + ½at² (Correct Answer)

Rationale: Standard equation of motion for distance under uniform acceleration.

C. v = u + at

Rationale: Formula for final velocity, not distance.

D. v² = u² + 2as

Rationale: Time variable t is absent in this equation.
